title: Private Pre Alaska Cruise Seattle Tour and Cruise Transport
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Offering a seamless transition from your hotel to the cruise terminal, this tour combines transportation with a captivating three-hour city tour of Seattle. Begin your adventure with convenient hotel pick-up and experience iconic sights like Pike Place Market and the Space Needle, all while enjoying insights from our knowledgeable guides. This customizable private tour is perfect for groups of 6-9 and ensures you arrive at your cruise ship on time, providing a stress-free start to your Alaskan journey.

- Convenient hotel pickup from most locations in greater Seattle
- Explore Seattle's highlights during a 3-hour guided city tour
- Guaranteed timely drop-off at your cruise ship
- Bring your luggage along
- Ideal for small groups (6-9) looking to discover Seattle before their cruise
